correctness.rationale: A maximal strong independent set cannot leave an expanded edge empty, since a fresh private vertex could be added; every edge must contain precisely one chosen vertex. Its original vertices form an independent base set. Conversely choosing exactly one private representative on edges not covered by a base independent set saturates all hyperedges, so no omitted private or original vertex can be inserted (the latter uses the isolate-free hypothesis). This is a bijection; its independent per-edge choice counts prove the full polynomial. The cardinality and well-covered conclusions follow by the disjoint incident-edge count; the cycle formula follows from circular gap compositions, the clique gaps follow from an empty/singleton split, and counting hardness is a one-call reduction from #independent-sets via joining a universal vertex. An independently written finite verifier checked the original definitions and complete maximal families for 156 instances, 567300 vertex subsets and 2498 maximal sets, and checked loose-cycle coefficients. Infinite correctness rests on proof, not finite samples.

originality.rationale: The main arXiv paper was read in full and studies general extremal bounds for maximal strong independence, not exact cardinality enumeration of hypergraph edge expansions. Searches of published research records for multiple formulations, and searches of primary papers/sequence databases for edge corona, hypergraph independence, maximal configurations and cycle special cases, found no directly dominating or equivalent statement. The 2026 independent-domination article on edge-corona graphs is highly relevant; its abstract addresses minimum-number formulas rather than this full polynomial and weighted bijection, but lack of accessible full text makes publication priority provisional. This is evidence-based best-knowledge originality, not a claim of exhaustive uniqueness.
residual_risks: The full 2026 edge-corona independent-domination article is subscription-gated in the available access path; an equivalent full classification there is not excluded.
Other unindexed or differently named literature may state the identical weighted-polynomial identity.
Semantic research-record search returns summaries, not full-paper noncoverage certificates.

value.rationale: This is a complete structural census of maximal strongly independent configurations for every base graph and every uniformity on a natural linear family. Its weighted independence-polynomial transfer encodes fine cardinality distributions, identifies the full strong-well-covered boundary (matchings only), gives exact loose-cycle coefficients and unbounded missing cardinality gaps in connected linear instances, and transfers #P-hardness to connected linear 3-uniform hypergraphs. These are motivated, reusable structural and computational consequences, not a routine numeric special case. Limits: the cycle/clique examples are corollaries rather than separate original results.
